appearance_facts.fact: Large bold title text reading 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023'.
A single solid blue line chart connecting data points for each year from 2018 to 2023.
The blue line fluctuates in the upper portion of the graph, starting high, dipping, rising to a peak, and then leveling off.
The line reaches its highest visual point (peak) at the 2020 mark.
The line reaches its lowest visual point (trough) at the 2019 mark.
From 2021 to 2023, the line becomes nearly horizontal, indicating a plateau with very slight downward slope.
